character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Original pixel-art female Dungeon Master for a dark-fantasy dungeon RPG. Elegant ancient elven mage with a calm, mysterious expression.  Design: - Long silver-white hair - Pointed elf ears - Pale skin, violet eyes - Black and deep-purple mage robe - Elegant dark cloak with purple lining - Small gold magical ornaments - Subtle dark crown/headpiece - Tall black staff with glowing purple crystal - Slender, graceful silhouette - Powerful but composed presence  Style: - Dark fantasy + elegant high-fantasy mage - Inspired by the atmosphere of Dungeon Maker and Frieren, but completely original - Cute/chibi RPG proportions - Crisp 32×32 or 48×48 pixel-art character - Dark outline, limited palette - Black, purple, silver and muted gold - Clean pixel clusters - No gradients, no anti-aliasing  Animation: 4-frame idle animation: 1. Standing calmly 2. Slight breathing/hair movement 3. Purple magic briefly glowing around her hand 4. Return to idle  Transparent background, consistent framing and scale, no text, no UI, no environment.
